description: For appliance installation, this completion sign-off form records connection requirements, code-listed parts, protection, leveling, anchoring, testing, haul-away, and customer orientation. Its supporting evidence includes delivery condition, fit measurements, connection photos, leak or electrical test, serial record, and operation check.

subtitle: Appliance Installation Completion Sign-Off Form: residential appliance delivery and installation using appliance model, connection requirements, and delivery condition.
title: Appliance Installation Completion Sign-Off Form
use_case: Use the completion sign-off form during residential appliance delivery and installation when the appliance installation record must identify appliance model, serial, location, dimensions, path, utilities, cabinetry, ventilation, and old-unit disposition. Complete the applicable handoff for installed condition, function verification, customer demonstration, warranty registration, debris removal, and signoff.
